│    behavior-specification
│
│      Turn accepted behavior into concrete acceptance examples and meaningful verification at stable boundaries.
│
│    code-review
│
│      Review the actual change for behavioral correctness, maintainability, security, compatibility and justified complexity using concrete evidence.
│
│    evidence-verification
│
│      Verify requested engineering behavior with executed checks and inspectable evidence; distinguish implemented, failed and unverified boundaries.
│
│    grill-with-docs
│
│      Resolve consequential unknowns in a feature or design using repository evidence and targeted stakeholder questions before committing to behavior.
│
│    implementation-planning
│
│      Plan dependent engineering work as demonstrable increments with concrete file changes, compatibility and risk-based verification.
│
│    lean-engineer
│
│      Choose and carry out proportionate engineering work, from a small authorized fix to discovery, architecture, implementation and verification of a complex feature.
│
│    requirements-engineering
│
│      Define precise business behavior, scope and consequential quality requirements from available evidence and stakeholder decisions.
│
│    solution-architecture
│
│      Inspect and design system boundaries, ownership and execution/data flows; compare architectural alternatives, failure behavior, migration and evolution with useful diagrams.
│
│    technical-design
│
│      Make concrete domain, data, API, algorithm and Python implementation decisions with precise semantics and proportionate boundaries.
│
│    test-driven-development
│
│      Implement authorized changes with meaningful failing checks, proportionate Python/code design, real boundary tests and honest regression evidence.
